subject: Marine Works - Trois-Rivières to Donnacona - Bécancour
text:
Marine Works - Trois-Rivières to Donnacona - Bécancour
Installation of temporary pipeline taking place Monday to Friday from 1000 UTC until 2200 UTC beginning 27 Apr 2026. Pipeline is afloat and extending from 46 22.893N 072 24.597W to 46 23.188N 072 25.080W and is equipped with yellow lights. Barges and work boats on site. 
Floating warning signs equipped with yellow flashing lights temporarily established at 46 23.028N 072 25.915W and 46 23.517N 072 24.542W. 
Four yellow cautionary buoys with yellow flashing lights temporarily established at:
46 22.888N 072 24.850W
46 23.197N 072 25.303W
46 23.338N 072 25.042W
46 22.978N 072 24.468W
Minimum wake requested.
